description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Cloud' that extends the system engine model class in OpenCart. The class manages database operations related to a 'product_bestseller' table, including installation (creating the table), uninstallation (dropping the table), editing totals, deleting entries, and retrieving reports and report totals.

classes.name: Cloud
classes.description: A model class within the OpenCart admin extension system that manages 'bestseller' product data in the database.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_bestseller' table if it does not exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_bestseller' table if it exists.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Replaces or inserts a record to update the total sales for a specific product.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes the record for a specific product from the 'product_bestseller' table.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of bestseller products ordered by total sales.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of bestseller records.
